metadata.title: Our Story | iGadget Pasdaran
metadata.description: Meet iGadget Pasdaran: nearly 30 years of mobile experience, honest advice, and clear explanations. Phones change. Our commitment to you stays the same.

hero.eyebrow: A little about the people behind the counter
hero.title: Phones changed.
hero.description: From the first keypads to the screens we carry today, one thing has stayed with us: a good conversation comes before a good recommendation. This is the iGadget story.
hero.yearsLabel: years of listening, learning, and helping you choose

memories.label: Explore phone generations
memories.hint: Pick a generation. Which one brings back a memory?

keypad.label: Keypad days
keypad.title: One more game of Snake?
keypad.description: Little screens. Big memories. And a message worth pressing a key three times for.

touch.label: First touch
touch.title: Suddenly, a world in your pocket.
touch.description: Our fingers learned to swipe. Our questions about choosing well stayed just as important.

today.label: Today
today.title: Smarter phones. The same human care.
today.description: More cameras, more choices. Still a simple question: what actually works for you?

mascot.label: A surprise visit from the iGadget mascot
mascot.first: I was here for the Snake game.
mascot.second: Found me! I am the unofficial historian.
mascot.third: New phone? I still have my old stories.

story.eyebrow: The part that never gets old
story.title: Technology moves on. Trust takes time.
story.approachTitle: What a conversation with us looks like

listen.title: First, tell us your story.
listen.description: How do you use your phone? What is bothering you? What budget feels comfortable? We start with your answers.

explain.title: Then, make the options clear.
explain.description: A repair, a different model, or keeping what you have: we explain the trade-offs and costs in everyday language.

choose.title: The last word is yours.
choose.description: Take your time, compare, and ask again. A choice should feel right to you, even if it means no purchase today.

story.footnote: A simple principle, carried into every conversation.

invitation.eyebrow: There is room for your story, too
invitation.title: Every good choice starts with a conversation.
invitation.description: A question about your next phone, a device that needs attention, or a little advice. Tell us what is on your mind.
invitation.contact: Find a way to reach us
invitation.note: A clear answer. Time to think. The choice is yours.

Story.title: This trust was not built overnight
Story.descriptionOne: Nearly 30 years in the mobile market means seeing generations of devices, brands, and technologies come and go. What has not changed is our responsibility toward each customer's decision and budget.
Story.descriptionTwo: Sometimes the right advice is not to buy a new phone. Repairing your current device, choosing a simpler model, or waiting a little longer may be the better decision. We will tell you when it is.
Story.quote: Trust is not a marketing line for us. It is the result of every clear explanation and every promise we have kept.

metadata.description: Find your starting point at iGadget Pasdaran: phone buying and selling, hardware repair, software help, accessories, buying advice, and device health checks.

hero.eyebrow: Six services. A little less guesswork.
hero.title: Whatever brings you in.
hero.description: A phone that needs attention. A new device to choose. Or a question you haven’t quite put into words. Start with what you need; we’ll help you understand the options.
hero.note: You don’t need to know the technical name for a problem. Your own words are a good place to start.

finder.title: The service switchboard
finder.label: What brings you in?

trade.label: Buying or selling

repair.label: Something’s broken

software.label: Setup or software trouble

accessories.description: Match an accessory to your device, your daily use, and your budget. Compatibility comes first.

consultation.label: Too many phone choices

healthCheck.label: Is this phone healthy?

mascot.label: A surprise visit from your service switchboard helper
mascot.first: Technical term: the thingy. I understand.
mascot.third: Even robots ask for a second opinion.

directory.title: Different needs. The same care.
directory.description: Here’s what each service is for, plus a useful first question to bring to the conversation. A recommendation starts with understanding your device and your priorities.

prompts.trade: Which model are you buying or selling, and what condition is it in? Tell us what you have in mind.
prompts.repair: What isn’t working, and when did it start? Mention any drop, damage, or previous repair you know about.
prompts.software: What are you trying to do, and what happens instead? For data transfer, tell us which two devices are involved.
prompts.accessories: Which device is it for, and how will you use it? Share the model so we can discuss compatible options.
prompts.consultation: What do you use your phone for most? Your priorities and a comfortable budget make comparisons more useful.
prompts.healthCheck: Are you buying, selling, or deciding about a repair? Tell us what you’d like to understand about the phone.

conversation.title: Bring the question. We’ll start there.
conversation.description: No technical vocabulary needed. These details can make the first conversation easier.

checklist.story: What’s happening, when it started, and anything you’ve already tried. Your observations are useful.
checklist.priorities: What matters most to you: daily use, keeping your current phone, or a budget you’re comfortable with.
